title: DBP: physical FIR initialization vs identity (delta, alpha = 0), with calibration on trained DBP
question: (1) Do the trained DBP FIR steps of E018/E025/E028 follow H = exp(j c nu^2) with c * Ns close to the literature value? (2) Does a physical initialization of the DBP FIR (and alpha) speed up convergence, reduce the seed spread or improve BER at the same RM?
eval_rule: validation and (report-only) test every max(500, steps/40) steps; selection only by validation

link.source: из литературы (Bogdanov, Sidelnikov 2021), не проверено на генераторе
link.c_step: c = s * beta2 * (2000 km / Ns) * Rs^2 / 2 (c_total = -21.5 rad); dz = 2000 km / Ns, Ns is defined for the whole link

physical_init_allowed: Ns >= 8 with L = 31 (94 % of the response energy in the window), Ns >= 16 with L = 15 (93 %); A1 (one Kerr, FIR7) has no physical filter by design
sign_rule: s = sign of the median fitted c of the trained steps with r2 >= 0.5 (stage calib); sign_fallback if no step fits
alpha_source: E015 alpha_fit_R1.csv (direct fit, R = 1), split equally over Ns steps (as E022 dbp_fixed)

arms.phys_fir: FIR = physical taps of c_step, alpha = 0
arms.phys_fir_alpha: physical FIR + alpha_centre / Ns on the centre coefficient

value_filter.changes_next_step: yes: a signal opens the rest of E049 (physical CNN P1); no signal stops it
value_filter.answered_in_literature: partly (physical DBP initialization is standard); not on our CD-compensated single-polarization data
value_filter.needed_for_main_claim: yes: DBP is the strongest rival below ~2.5k RM

decision_if_positive: rest of E049 (physical CNN P1 with F1-F4 FIR modes) after E048
decision_if_negative: stop E049; report which tricks contributed

rule_draft.status: DRAFT: to be confirmed by the user before the first run; must not change after results are seen
rule_draft.calibration: reported: median c_fit * Ns per (Ns, L) against c_total = -21.5 rad, fit quality r2; agreement if |c_fit * Ns| is within a factor 1.5 of 21.5 with r2 >= 0.5
rule_draft.signal: a physical arm shows a signal if, at the same RM, it beats delta in test by > 2 SE (SE = s / sqrt(10)), or reaches 90 % of the final validation of delta in at most half the steps (mean over seeds), or halves the seed std; 2 std is reported as well
